terminology_correction.pilot_answerability: CONCEPTUAL/INTENT answerability only (whether user intent corresponds to a conceivable eligible policy), NOT corpus-grounded source-truth answerability. The prior '85% answerable' was concept-level intuition and MUST NOT be used as corpus-grounded sizing evidence. Final frozen benchmark answerability will be source-truth grounded: every headline task must have >=1 grade>=2 (source,source_id) validated against source-truth; unsupported has none; ambiguous is safety-only.
